_comment: PLAN-001 (031) P0.3 -- the registration-shape gate's fixtures (ADR-001 D2 'The gate's fixtures',
(no producer, no cache; add --ailang-check to assert `compiler`) and by
`make ext_hook_scope_selftest`, which also runs the walk and asserts `verdict` where pinned.
Every fixture is SYNTHETIC. The escapes are P0.2's group-3 and group-4 constructions re-cast
onto the 8.0 `{ config, caps }` head (scripts/dst/fixtures/adr001_boundary/ holds the sources
the reviews quoted, on the 7.4 head); nothing here is from a session.
GROUPS. `pass`: the positive controls -- a reader that resolves nothing passes every fail row,
so these carry the suite. `fail`: one per rejection reason in `SHAPE_REASONS`; the self-test
refuses a reason no fixture reaches. `fail-compiler-clean`: P0.2's group 4 -- the import shadow
the pinned compiler resolves the OTHER way (N62); the rule over-rejects it by design and the
`compiler: clean` pin is what says so. `form`: one per in-tree registration form at HEAD, on
the 7.4 head; P1.2 rewrites each to the migrated form and flips its pin to pass, batch by batch.
`fx_residue` is the row that shows the two results are distinct: its walk verdict is
HOOK-UNRESOLVED (`show`, door 3) and its shape result is PASS. `fx_delegated_record` records a
READING of D2's grammar taken by P0.3: the record is written at `register_with_config`'s tail
and delegation is admitted at `caps`; a record reached only behind a delegation is unsupported.
If P1.2 needs the other reading, that is a numbered amendment citing this fixture, not a re-pin.
